content.short: Fonbnk is a stablecoin settlement layer bridging mobile-first, cash-based economies to onchain payments.
content.description: Fonbnk is an on-ramp and off-ramp built for Africa, Latin America and South East Asia, covering nineteen markets and fourteen chains. Integrators choose a zero-code widget that handles KYC, payment collection, settlement and stablecoin delivery, or a signed REST API using HMAC-SHA256 for orders, limits and reconciliation. A merchant workspace configures integrations and monitors order flow in one place. Typical routes move local currency in markets such as Nigeria, Kenya and South Africa into USDC or USDT.
